reader_summary.overview: with Jyoti Bansal (@jyotibansalsf), Peter Levine, Satish Talluri (@satishtalluri). The concept can be defined many ways, but the simple definition shared in this episode is: it's when you understand the business value of your product. And that comes down to users, which is where the concept of "product-market-sales fit" comes in, observes Jyoti Bansal.
